items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: See that place, Lucian Tenor... We met, we were playing there for years.

ctx.x: Stag. It wasn't stag dance. Winners, winners, and maybe a little gravy and macaroni, or have somebody to cook the dinner, have somebody to cook for them. Maybe chicken and macaroni, you know, and winners, and beer. And as well as the beer and cags, you see, and whiskey and wine and all that. Well some of them would want it, they'd get a shot at it, you know. Different places, they'd be there in most different clubs to play. See that place, Lucian Tenor, out here on Dolphin and Legion Field? We met, we were…
